arguments.title: FE-27 Flight Deconfliction Brief
arguments.body:
## FE-27 Flight Deconfliction Brief

**Mission Block:** FE-27
**Date:** September 4
**Time Window:** 06:30–08:00
**Launch Point:** LP-3
**Altitude Cap:** 120 meters AGL
**Protected-Zone Avoidance:** EB-7 — avoidance required
**Status:** Pending final airspace clearance

### Summary
Mission block FE-27 is authorized for September 4, 06:30–08:00, operating from launch point LP-3 with a maximum altitude of 120 meters AGL. Flight operations must avoid protected-zone designator EB-7. Final airspace clearance is pending; operations may not commence until clearance is confirmed.

### Deconfliction Notes
- All flight paths must maintain clearance from EB-7.
- Altitude must not exceed 120 meters AGL.
- Launch is restricted to LP-3.
- Confirm final airspace clearance before deployment.
